sourceSearch.result: Exact product STEP is extracted from the retained original official archive; container and member byte hashes are independently checked. No Git revision is invented for ZIP-only material.

materialBasis: Original native linear RGB converted to sRGB; native shapes without supplied color use explicit neutral grey.
assemblyNotes: Unscaled native solids/shells; global rigid coordinate transform puts screen toward+Z. Debug separation is not operating spacing.
limitations: Native manufacturer CAD revision may differ from current production. No hardware fit or browser WebGL acceptance.
The emissive face is projected above the native cover solely to show the live framebuffer; that rendering offset is not glass thickness.
Uncolored native components use neutral grey; no fabricated silkscreen or hidden battery.
Published33.75 mm viewing and native33.55 mm emissive diameters are not conflated. The physical cover is36.4 mm, trim34.3 mm.

Native switch positions are preserved. Exact photographic BOOT/PWR-to-topology registration is unverified, so the3D switches remain unbound while source-backed GPIO9/GPIO1 controls remain available in the workbench.

source.stp.gz.grouping: Every native topology preserved; rigid source-coordinate transform only, no scaling.
